testcase.name: Scenario: ellipse-21 Cancel the lower-slider preview: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/sketch/ellipse/scenario.feature:247:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: ellipse-21 Cancel the lower-slider preview ✔ Given a copy of `fixtures/cad/ellipse/rotated-measured.opd` is open with Sketch1 being edited in RIGHT view ✔ And the user enables Display Curvature, records both slider positions, previews an upper-slider change and cancels it ✔ Given the ellipse has curvature display enabled ✔ And the prior upper-slider preview was cancelled ✔ And its original upper and lower thumb positions were recorded ✔ When the user reopen Curvature Settings ✔ Then the upper and lower thumbs have their earlier restored positions ✔ When the user advance only the lower slider ✔ Then the comb envelope expands without a visible ellipse shape change ✔ And the upper slider stays at its earlier position ✔ And OK and Apply are enabled ✔ When the user click Cancel ✔ Then the earlier comb envelope returns with curvature still enabled
